Bangkok to Phuket

Fly BKK or DMK to HKT in about 80 minutes. The bus is a night you will not get back.

FlightAbout 80 minutes to HKT
Then45-90 minutes to the west-coast beaches
SeasonEasier November to April

HKT has Trip.com airport cars. Tell the driver the beach, not just Phuket.

Common questions

Can you land and boat to Phi Phi the same day?
Only if you land early and the sea is flat. A first trip should sleep on Phuket first.
